issue.title: Quality of documentation
issue.body:
# 📚 Docs or angular.io bug report ### Description A clear and concise description of the problem... **1. Using obscure declarations to explain obscure concepts is a horrible way of writing documentation. 2. The use of line numbering added to source code, adds a terrible experience to the horrible documentation 3. The use of code snippets outside of real examples make them useless! Where do things go?** ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction For example: **"Observables Observables provide support for passing messages between publishers and subscribers in your application. Observables offer significant benefits over other techniques for event handling, asynchronous programming, and handling multiple values."** ### What's the affected URL?** https://angular.io/... The whole site. ### Reproduction Steps** Put a non experienced person in Angular to read. ### Expected vs Actual Behavior** ## 📷Screenshot ## 🔥 Exception or Error
## 🌍 Your Environment ### Browser info ### Anything else relevant?
